systems.name: Nasdaq big-move continuation
systems.why: On days the index has already moved > 2 sigma by 13:30 New York, option-dealer gamma hedging and leveraged-ETF rebalancing push the same way into the close (Baltussen, Da, Lammers & Martens 2021; Gao et al. 2018).
systems.rules: At 13:30 NY: if price is beyond the trigger level, enter in that direction at once. Stop = half of the day's move given back. Exit at 16:00 NY. No trade if neither trigger is reached.
levels: Normal move to decision time (1 sigma)
systems.status_text: Move was -1.0 sigma at 13:30: below the 2 sigma trigger.

systems.name: S&P 500 big-move continuation
systems.why: Same mechanism as the Nasdaq version: hedging flows late in the session continue large moves.
systems.rules: At 13:30 NY: if price is beyond the trigger level, enter in that direction. Stop = half the day's move given back. Exit 16:00 NY.
levels: Normal move to decision time (1 sigma)
systems.status_text: Move was -0.7 sigma at 13:30: below the 2 sigma trigger.

systems.name: Gold big-move continuation
systems.why: A > 2 sigma move by 10:00 New York (after London and the US data releases) tends to extend through the NY session.
systems.rules: At 10:00 NY: if gold is beyond the trigger level, enter in that direction. Stop = half the move since yesterday's 16:00 given back. Exit 16:00 NY.
levels: Normal move to decision time (1 sigma)
systems.status_text: Move was +0.4 sigma at 10:00: below the 2 sigma trigger.

systems.name: Month-end pension rebalancing
systems.why: Pension and balanced funds must bring their stock/bond weights back to target at month end. If stocks beat bonds this month they sell stocks on the last trading day (and buy if stocks lagged). Research round 6: positive in 2014-19, 2020-22 and 2023-26, passed the false-discovery test.
systems.rules: Last US trading day of the month only. Direction is known before the open: AGAINST the month-to-date return of the S&P 500 minus Treasury bonds (IEF, total return). Enter at the 09:30 NY open, stop 1 x daily ATR, exit 16:00 NY.
systems.alt: Nasdaq version is the same bet (+0.115R, but negative in 2020-22): do not take both at full size.
systems.status_text: Next rebalancing day: 2026-11-30 (10 trading days away). Direction if it stays like this: SHORT S&P 500.

systems.name: Pre-FOMC drift
systems.why: Stocks tend to rise in the 24 hours before a scheduled Fed decision (Lucca & Moench 2015). Weak in 2014-19, strong in 2020-22, moderate since: treat as a candidate.
systems.rules: Buy Nasdaq at 14:00 NY on the day before a scheduled FOMC decision, stop 1 x daily ATR, exit at 14:00 NY on decision day (before the 14:00 statement).

systems.name: DAX 30-min opening range breakout (with trend)
systems.why: The first 30 minutes of Xetra set the day's battle lines; a break in the direction of the daily trend tends to run (opening-range breakout, Crabel 1990; Zarattini & Aziz 2023).
systems.rules: After 09:30 Frankfurt: one stop order at the 30-min range high (if daily trend up) or low (if down). Stop = other side of the range. Exit 17:30. Orders expire 16:30.

systems.name: Nasdaq noise-band momentum
systems.why: Moves that leave the normal intraday 'noise area' (time-of-day average move of the last 14 days) tend to continue (Zarattini, Aziz & Barbon 2024, 'Beat the Market').
systems.rules: Every :00 and :30 NY from 10:00 to 15:30: if the half-hour closes above the upper band -> long; below the lower band -> short. Exit when a half-hour closes back inside the band, or at 16:00. R = band distance from the open.
systems.status_text: SHORT since 10:00 NY. Exit on a half-hour close back inside the band.

regime.label: high
regime.note: The gap comes mostly from 2014-19; since 2020 both regimes are similar.

systems.name: London breakout of the Asian range
systems.why: Liquidity arriving at the London open breaks the quiet Asian range; the first break tends to carry through the day.
systems.rules: At 07:00 London: buy stop at the 00:00-07:00 high and sell stop at the low (one cancels the other), valid until 12:00. Stop = other side of the range. Exit 17:00 London.
systems.status_text: Range not broken before 12:00: no trade today.
